text:
Nora: Heads-up 1: Cascade Labs sent over their onboarding packet for their new 30B conversational model. They want a managed endpoint, a "validated-on-TitanEdge" SKU, and a joint launch at their partner summit. Thoughts?
Sam: Cube: legal + export. Also need to confirm allowed downstream use (commercial fine-tuning?)
Ellen: Eng: we can do a validated-on-TitanEdge SKU but HWCo requires a hardware attestation tag and a partner-approved performance claim.
Ravi: @Nora can you paste the license excerpt? We need to know if they allow hosted inference vs downloadable checkpoints.
Nora: Pasted below.

"""
License excerpt: Section 2.1(b): "Provider permits Redwood to host the Model weights for inference services; redistribution of weights as downloadable artifacts is prohibited. Provider permits derivative quantized artifacts for service delivery, provided they are not sublicensed for resale. Commercial fine-tuning on customer data requires separate licensing."
"""

Diego: Marketing: Summit slot looks doable if we lock the asset approvals. We'll need logos, a 30-50 word joint blurb, and an approved demo by T-12 business days.
legal-bot: Reminder: export controls checklist required (ECCN, BIS self-classification).
Sam: Legal: note the "no-download" restriction. That blocks some channel partners who bundle downloads. We should negotiate a limited enterprise-only download carveout under NDA.
Ellen: Technical checklist we asked for: model-card, tokenizer files, sample prompts, memory traces, and a reproducible checksum. Our packaging expects: 
```
model-card.yaml
tokenizer.json
pytorch_state.bin
quant-manifest.json
benchmarks/latency_trace.csv
```

Ravi: Also request a statement about third-party data in pretraining. Our compliance team needs to know whether the model was trained on licensed datasets or web crawl.
Nora: Cascade replied: "No licensed third-party corpora; mixture of public web and internal corpora." That might trigger review.
Sam: If they used internal proprietary datasets, we need IP warranties and representation language. Add to redline.
Diego: About HW bundle: TitanEdge marketing team will want to co-sign the SKU name. I can intro folks but TitanEdge does require an extra go-to-market addendum.
legal-bot: Added task: "Cascade: request ECCN, dataset provenance, and allowed distributions" assigned to Sam, due 2026-03-01.
Ellen: If quantized derivatives are allowed, we can ship fp16 and int8 managed SKUs. For on-prem encrypted bundles, confirm whether the "no-download" rule still applies (it would).
Ravi: Suggest proposing a two-tier reseller carveout: 1) enterprise resellers with compliance attestations (allowed to distribute encrypted artifacts to enterprise customers only), 2) marketplace resellers remain blocked. Legal needs indemnity & audit rights for tier 1.
Sam: Agreed. I'll draft a clause: limited distribution to authorized resellers under audit + indemnity.
Nora: Timeline: Cascade wants listing before their May summit. Tight but workable if we get license confirmations within 10 business days.
Diego: Marketing proposes a short demo notebook and a recorded 10-min talk. If we can embed a lightweight interactive sample (no downloads), that would be ideal.
Ellen: Also requesting benchmark traces for long-context scenarios (32k tokens) if available. Routing/trace caching depends on that.
Nora: Action list: 1) Sam to circulate license redline, 2) Ellen to finalize packaging checklist and target SKUs, 3) Ravi to run privacy/dataset questions with compliance, 4) Diego to start co-marketing ask with TitanEdge. Regroup next Tue 9am.
Diego: noted. :thumbsup:
marketing-bot: Created asset request: "Cascade partner summit assets" due 2026-04-20.
Nora: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Cascade and share updates in-thread.
